recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No current FHIR source follow-up is needed for FHIR-21237; changing to the exact suggested phrase would be unnecessary churn.
issue_request: FHIR-21237 was Published/Persuasive for R5 by Pharmacy. It requested changing MedicationRequest.category short from "Type of medication usage" to "Classification of medication request" so the element could classify the medication request rather than only medication use.
initial_application: Jira records implementation in merge commit b60fb4b7d3fe218dfc65fc253645e4c6c79d4708. The underlying source commit 634360b51d40494b5427df25cc2ecce831d928e4 changed the MedicationRequest spreadsheet short to "Grouping or category of medication request" and updated the definition to request grouping/category wording.
additional_context: The current build lists medicationrequest=MedicationRequest in source/fhir.ini, and the active StructureDefinition has short "Grouping or category of medication request" with definition/comment text allowing arbitrary categorization of the request, including administration setting, other request types, and legal category. The old "Type of medication usage" text appears only in tools/history release artifacts. Focused Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later conflicting decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current authoritative source already satisfies the approved request with semantically equivalent and broader wording than the exact 2019 suggestion.
